description: Ready-to-use character set for the sprite ABI. A game (native or a WASM guest) references a character by numeric id — like it references a sound by RG_WASM_SOUND_* — and the host resolves id -> sheet + animation rows. Baked by lpc_compose.rgr: with the full Universal-LPC art (LPC_ROOT) each character gets its own layer stack (tunic/plate+greathelm/robe+wizard hat/leather+hood — see buildFullCharCalls); with only the embedded demo-male-walk pack they fall back to recolours of the shared male-walk stack (see gallery/game_engine/lpc/src/lpc_char_catalog.rgr).

walk.note: The 4 sheet rows ARE the directions (compact walk-only strip).

run.note: Reserves the real LPC run rows; falls back to walk until expanded art is baked.

jump.note: Reserves the real LPC jump rows; host synthesises a hop (holdFrame + hopPixels) until art is present.
